records.name: Turkmenistan
records.note: no prison-housing data found: the mandated single enwiki full-text search (Turkmenistan transgender prisoner housing) returned no country-relevant placement content, and the shared candidate article 'LGBTQ people in prison' (enwiki, fetched, HTTP 200, cached research/fetched/58ce7836f80217d1.txt) contains no Turkmenistan mention at all. A US State Dept 2024 Country Report on Human Rights Practices fetch for Turkmenistan returned a bot-wall 'Technical Difficulties' page with no prisoner or transgender content (fetch failed; no refetch per budget). Turkmenistan has no legal gender recognition and criminalises male same-sex conduct (batch sources: ILGA-Europe AR 2025, ECOM 2019), so trans people are legally treated as birth sex, but no source documents birth-sex-vs-identity placement, trans special units, or solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners; no usable finding.
